posts.description: A few months ago, I wrote an essay called Cats Might Just Be Enlightened in which I explored the wisdom of cats. As an obvious follow-up, I thought it would be interesting to ponder the wisdom of dogs as well. posts.title: You can't think your way into happiness.
posts.description: I once decided to be happy. Quite a few years ago, as arrogant as it may seem, I truly thought that I had solved happiness. I had been contemplating the meaning of happiness and had a Eureka moment. The insight I was so proud of was simple: True happiness is a choice. It was a bold yet empowering claim.
